name: SoulSync
description: Intelligent music and video automation platform. Discover, download, organize and sync media using Soulseek and other sources with support for Navidrome, Jellyfin and Plex.

paths.name: Database
paths.description: Persistent SoulSync music and video databases and related application data.

paths.name: Downloads
paths.description: Shared input directory. For slskd integration, map the same host directory into both containers.

paths.name: Music Library
paths.description: Destination for organized music used by Navidrome, Jellyfin or Plex.

paths.name: Staging
paths.description: Optional staging and import directory used by SoulSync.

paths.name: Music Videos
paths.description: Optional destination for downloaded music videos.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: User ID used by SoulSync for file ownership. MOS recommended default: 500.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: Group ID used by SoulSync for file ownership. MOS recommended default: 500.

variables.name: UMASK
variables.description: Permission mask for files created by SoulSync.

variables.name: Spotify OAuth Callback Port
variables.description: Spotify OAuth callback port. Must match the mapped port and configured redirect URI.

variables.name: Tidal OAuth Callback Port
variables.description: Tidal OAuth callback port. Must match the mapped port and configured redirect URI.
